# THE patch list of the library: read by 09-Install/oracle_software_version.conf
# (sets INSTALL_PATCHES, WLS_SPB_PATCH_NR, JDK_PATCH_NR, ...) and downloaded by
# 70-Customer-Projects/tools/mos_patch_download.sh - with or without the library:
#   mos_patch_download.sh -c patches_fmw.csv -d $PATCH_STORAGE --all [--apply]
# Sources: KA1182 (CPU tab FMW 14.1.2), KA204 (F&R QPR), docs/00-patch-references.md,
# 70-Customer-Projects/Forms14_reports14_patch_analyse_10_2026/README.md.
# Maintained per cycle (CPU/CSPU) - update this file, not the scripts. README.md here.
# Columns : patch
#   platform    MOS platform code(s), alternatives with "|" tried in order:
#               226P = Linux x86-64, 2000P = Generic, 233P = Windows x64
#   file_regexp file of the patch (Java regex, whole file name)
#   required    yes | optional (optional: library decides by environment.conf)
#   step        role in the library: opatch spb wls fr_common reports forms
#               fr_optional jdk client_jdk cvu apex - rows of one role in apply order
#   dir         target directory below PATCH_STORAGE (empty = <patch>)
#   sha256      SHA-256 at analysis time - soft check only (WARN): Oracle may
#               re-release a patch under the same number (JDK: every update)
